nary_nodes.label: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake in Colombia
evidence: Colombia was hit by one of its largest earthquakes in years.
The magnitude 7.4 quake struck at 07:34 (12:34 GMT) at a depth of 103km (64 miles) in Chocó province

evidence: At least 169 people are dead

evidence: He explained that due to previous earthquakes, the city has "very strict seismic-resistant building regulations"
